For example, it describes how the Egyptians begged the Israelites for their departure, showing fear and desperation ('וַתְּהִי צְעָקָה גְדוֹלָה בְּמִצְרָיִם כִּי אֵין בַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אֵין שָׁם מֵת - And there was a great cry throughout Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead). It also mentions that the Israelites asked the Egyptians for silver and gold ('וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כִדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב - And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment).
